derivation: Hand-calculated ATR over a deterministic 6-bar M5 OHLC series with period=2, using true range TR[0]=high-low, TR[i]=max(high-low, |high-prior_close|, |low-prior_close|), first ATR = mean(TR[0:2]) at index 1, then Wilder smoothing ATR[i] = (ATR[i-1]*(period-1) + TR[i]) / period. ADR is hand-calculated over a deterministic 4-day D1 series with period=2 as the inclusive rolling mean of (high-low), which is a constant range of 1.0 for every day in this fixture.

rolling_volatility.derivation: Hand-calculated as the sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of each pair of consecutive log returns of the close-price series [100, 101, 99, 102, 98, 103], multiplied by sqrt(252), using the approved period+1-price rolling window.

atr_percent.derivation: Hand-calculated as 100*ATR/close over the atr_bars fixture (period=2), reusing the atr golden ATR values [null, 1.25, 1.125, 1.5625, 1.28125, 1.640625] divided by the matching close [9.5, 10.5, 10.0, 11.5, 11.0, 12.5].

parkinson_volatility.derivation: Hand-calculated as sqrt(A/(4*n*ln2) * mean(ln(H/L)^2)) over a trailing 2-bar window of the atr_bars fixture high/low pairs.

garman_klass_volatility.derivation: Hand-calculated as sqrt(A/n * mean(0.5*ln(H/L)^2 - (2ln2-1)*ln(C/O)^2)) over a trailing 2-bar window of the atr_bars fixture OHLC, clamping any negative windowed mean to zero within a tiny tolerance.

rogers_satchell_volatility.derivation: Hand-calculated as sqrt(A/n * mean(ln(H/O)*ln(H/C) + ln(L/O)*ln(L/C))) over a trailing 2-bar window of the atr_bars fixture OHLC.

ewma_volatility.derivation: Hand-calculated as the seeded RiskMetrics EWMA of squared log returns of the rolling_bars close series [100, 101, 99, 102, 98, 103], with the first squared return as the seed variance, annualized by sqrt(252).

bollinger_bandwidth.derivation: Hand-calculated as 100*(Upper-Lower)/Middle over a trailing 2-bar SMA/sample-stdev (ddof=1) window of the rolling_bars close series [100, 101, 99, 102, 98, 103], with k=2.
